implementation_strategy: Hosted-generation via openai_responses (gpt-5-mini) for initial shared candidate per intent; dockerized deterministic verifier (Batfish-style image) runs canonical reachability/policy checks; guarded pipeline invokes one deterministic repair generation call when verifier fails; deterministic rule-based gate accepts/rejects based on verifier trace; all scoring and exclusion logic implemented as deterministic code within execution harness.
public_resources: canonical topology pack (public router topologies + synthetic variants)
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (hosted via openai_responses) — single generation endpoint for all initial candidates; same version for repair calls
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic selection using adapter's challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile (precomputed task_indices array above). Selection fixed before any model calls; no random sampling.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Canonicalization (whitespace/ordering, interface naming, ASN rewriting) and ACL-to-AST normalization applied deterministically prior to verifier; transformations validated via unit tests and semantic-AST diffs.
randomisation_plan: None for task selection (deterministic profile). Within-batch processing deterministic order; no random seeds required for selection.
caching_plan: Cache all model responses (initial + repair) and verifier outputs locally with content-addressed hashes; reuse cached artifacts on deterministic re-execution attempts; cache stored on CPU-backed storage.
failure_recovery_plan: On provider/infrastructure error: one deterministic retry of the failed model call; if still failing, drop the entire intent pair from primary analysis per 'complete_pair_primary' rule and log all failures and hashes. All retries and failures recorded in execution manifest.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 — per-intent record includes: intent_id, task_index, shared_initial_generation, baseline_proposal, guarded_proposal(s), verifier_logs (baseline and guarded), repair_attempt_log (if any), deterministic_gate_decision, binary_unsafe_flag per condition, latency_ms per step, cryptographic hashes of artifacts.
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model calls = 200 shared initial calls + expected ~60 repair calls (assumes ~30% initial verifier failures) = 260 calls. Max allowed = 400 (2 per task). Dockerized verifier runs on CPU; hosted model API used for all generation/repair. End-to-end wallclock expected <7 days under normal hosted API throughput and batching; token volume within hosted quota given max_output_tokens=2000 and conservative prompt sizing.
